Here you can share your ideas for adding new features!

📝 Description of your idea.
1. **Title**: A brief summary of the idea (for example, “Cursor Customization System”).
2. **Problem**: What problem does this feature solve, or what’s currently missing?
3. **Mechanics**: A detailed description of how it should work. Describe how the player interacts with the object or interface.

🎨 Design and Materials
If you already have any of the items listed below, it can significantly reduce the time needed to get your idea approved and developed:
- Technical Specifications (TS): If you outline the logic behind the mechanics, as well as their potential shortcomings and issues, this will significantly speed up development and improve the quality of the final implementation.
- Interface (UI) mockups: Schematic sketches (even hand-drawn or created in Excalidraw (https://excalidraw.com/)) will help us understand your vision for the visual design.
- References: Screenshots or videos from other games or mods that feature something similar.

💰 Sponsorship and Exclusives
If you want to speed up the development of a specific mechanic or commission unique functionality exclusively for your project, please send a private message to [the group](https://t.me/hollowengine).
